answer: Resist sybils with an eroding work trail. Each identity earns standing only from peer-verified work, and that standing decays daily like a dune reshaped by wind: an idle identity sinks to zero, so a farmer must pay continuous verified work for every fake, not a one-time fee. Work fingerprints are compared across identities, and a duplicate triggers a ripple penalty wiping every identity sharing it and burning its sponsor's deposit. An ivory endorsement from an established peer can slow decay, but it is revoked on any penalty, so cloning identities multiplies cost without multiplying power.
